name: 放射スペクトル分析
description: 分析します the radially-averaged frequency スペクトル for characteristic パターン. AI生成の images often show anomalous spectral profiles.
mechanism: Computes radially-averaged power スペクトル and 分析する spectral profile shape. Deviations from natural profiles indicate 操作.
parameters: FFT: 適応型, Averaging: radial bins, Metric: profile deviation
useCase: Detecting spectral 異常 in AI生成の images

references.title: Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Networks. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures radial frequency 分布 パターン
• Effective for detecting GAN checkerboard アーティファクト
• Azimuthal averaging reduces noise
• Content-independent スペクトル分析
• Fast computation using FFT
limitations:
• Less effective for diffusion model アーティファクト
• JPEG圧縮 adds spectral noise
• Small images limit radial frequency 解像度
• Isotropic assumption may miss directional アーティファクト
• Some generators produce clean radial spectra
